text: AI agents cannot self-certify. An AI assertion cannot create PL VERIFIED.
UNKNOWN is the default. Missing evidence never becomes positive state through inference.
Evidence is not proof. Evidence exists independently of verification.
Verification executes. VERIFIED requires execution of an authorized verification procedure.
Corruption is visible. Malformed canonical state cannot silently disappear.
History is immutable. Historical decisions and evidence are not rewritten.
Supersession is explicit. Replacing a requirement creates a new record linked to the old one.
Source truth and runtime truth differ. A source artifact cannot prove runtime behavior.
Deployment and implementation differ. Compilation cannot prove deployment.
Shipped has a formal definition: implemented VERIFIED and deployed VERIFIED and proven VERIFIED.
Deterministic core. Truth determination MUST NOT depend on generative AI.
Authority is explicit. Every authoritative record has an identifiable origin.

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I1); enforced by the PL verifier, never by the AI.
enforcement_point: PL verify pipeline: only PL execution may emit VERIFIED. The canon CLI has no command that writes a verification verdict.
evidence_method: Attempt `canon add-principle ... verified=true` → rejected as unknown field; audit PL code for absence of any mark_proven path.
scope: All verification and proof claims in CANON/PL workflows.
statement: AI agents cannot self-certify. An AI assertion cannot create PL VERIFIED.
violation_behavior: Fail-closed: any record attempting to assert verification state is rejected (exit 4); existing claims are untouched; the attempt is ledgered.

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I2); enforced by canon search/context/audit.
enforcement_point: canon search with no match prints an explicit NO ACTIVE DECISION FOUND marker; context receipt marks unavailable PL state as UNKNOWN, never blank.
evidence_method: Run `canon search <gibberish>` → exit 0 with NO ACTIVE DECISION FOUND marker on stdout.
scope: All CANON queries, context receipts, and status derivations.
statement: UNKNOWN is the default. Missing evidence never becomes positive state through inference.
violation_behavior: Fail-closed: queries return an explicit UNKNOWN marker; no empty-success path exists.

enforcement_point: Schema allowlist: CANON records have no verification-verdict field; context receipt queries PL live instead of caching verdicts.
evidence_method: Attempt `canon add-principle ... verified=true` → exit 2, argument rejected and never silently dropped; store-level unknown fields → exit 4.
scope: The CANON↔PL boundary; all claim/evidence references.
statement: Evidence is not proof. Evidence exists independently of verification.
violation_behavior: Fail-closed: append with a verdict-like field is rejected as an unknown field (exit 4).

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I4); procedure owned by the PL lane.
enforcement_point: Context receipt surfaces PL FAILED dimensions as violations (V2); CANON never emits VERIFIED itself.
evidence_method: Rename the pl binary away → `canon context` prints the unavailable-PL UNKNOWN marker.
scope: PL verification lifecycle; CANON's surfacing of PL state.
statement: Verification executes. VERIFIED requires execution of an authorized verification procedure.
violation_behavior: Degrade-open on read, closed on write: receipt marks PL state UNKNOWN when the pl binary is unavailable; no verdict is invented.

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I5, §23-24); enforced by canon audit.
enforcement_point: canon audit: read_strict fails on any malformed line; verify_chain fails on any hash/prev_hash mismatch (exit 3).
evidence_method: Hash-chain suite (tests/hashchain.rs): corruption, mid-file truncation, duplicate, malformed-record cases all green.
statement: Corruption is visible. Malformed canonical state cannot silently disappear.
violation_behavior: Fail-closed: audit exits 3; no partial or skipped-and-continued results are trusted.

enforcement_point: Append-only CLI surface (no update/delete command exists); duplicate-id rejection; fs2 exclusive lock serializes writers; fsync before success.
evidence_method: Enumerate CLI commands — no update/delete; tamper test → `canon audit` FAIL exit 3.
scope: All CANON stores and their git history.
statement: History is immutable. Historical decisions and evidence are not rewritten.
violation_behavior: No CLI path can mutate history; direct file edits are detected by audit (exit 3).

enforcement_point: canon supersede requires both endpoint ids to exist plus a reason; effective_status surfaces SUPERSEDED in search and context receipts.
evidence_method: `canon supersede from=NOPE to=X reason=y` → exit 4; search output always carries the [STATUS] tag.
scope: Record lifecycle for constitution, contracts, decisions.
statement: Supersession is explicit. Replacing a requirement creates a new record linked to the old one.
violation_behavior: Dangling endpoints rejected (exit 4); superseded records are never returned as active (C12).

enforcement_point: Receipt records git revision AND working_tree state AND live PL state as three separate fields.
evidence_method: `canon context` output contains distinct `revision:`, `working_tree:`, and CURRENT PL STATE sections.
scope: Context receipts; any reasoning about deployed behavior.
statement: Source truth and runtime truth differ. A source artifact cannot prove runtime behavior.
violation_behavior: Receipt never conflates them: revision, DIRTY/CLEAN, and PL dimensions are printed on separate lines.

enforcement_point: Receipt PL STATE section separates implemented/deployed/proven per claim; no single done field exists in any schema.
evidence_method: Inspect schema-2 allowlists (store.rs allowed_fields) — no completion-shortcut fields present.
statement: Deployment and implementation differ. Compilation cannot prove deployment.
violation_behavior: Schema allowlist contains no done/deployed shortcut fields; any such field is rejected on append.

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I10); work-order §B7. Computed by the PL lane.
enforcement_point: CANON records the rule; PL computes overall=shipped. Receipt REQUIRED NEXT ACTION names the blocking dimension.
evidence_method: pl status --json overall field transitions only via PL verification events, never via CANON writes.
scope: Release gating across the thesis-defense work order.
statement: Shipped has a formal definition: implemented VERIFIED and deployed VERIFIED and proven VERIFIED.
violation_behavior: CANON cannot declare shipped — no command or field exists for it; receipt degrades to naming the next action.

enforcement_point: Pure Rust, zero network, zero model calls; context(A)==context(A) is testable; receipt carries context_hash.
evidence_method: cargo test: receipt determinism + canonical-encoding determinism cases green; two `canon context` runs → identical context_hash.
scope: canon binary, audit, context receipts, hashing, tests.
statement: Deterministic core. Truth determination MUST NOT depend on generative AI.
violation_behavior: Any nondeterminism is a defect: receipt determinism is covered by an automated test.

authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I12; RFC-002 §32 authority matrix).
enforcement_point: Every record carries actor + created_at (UTC ISO); contracts validate constitution/decision refs on append; audit re-checks dangling refs.
scope: All CANON records and their references.
statement: Authority is explicit. Every authoritative record has an identifiable origin.
violation_behavior: Dangling constitution ref → exit 4; anonymous mutation via the API is impossible (actor always stamped).
